indeclinable particle of inclusion or emphasis

compound: bahir (external) + bhāvaḥ (state, manifestation); nominative subject

items.question: What is the essential nature of every accomplished external manifestation?
premises: An external manifestation may be accomplished.
Every such external manifestation is included without exception.
Its essential nature is characterized as all-knowing.
items.inference: Therefore, every accomplished external manifestation is inherently all-knowing in nature.
uncertainties: siddho could be read as referring to a perfected entity rather than an accomplished state, though it agrees with bahir+bhāvaḥ.
items.plain_english: Even every accomplished external manifestation is, in its essence, all-knowing.
